newsitem.title: USA: Producers Entertainment Group elects chairman.
newsitem.headline: Producers Entertainment Group elects chairman.

text.p: Producers Entertainment Group Ltd said Wednesday Los Angeles attorney Michael Dempsey has been elected as chairman of the board.

"Michael has been general counsel to TPEG since its founding in 1989 and a member of its board since 1996," chief executive Irwin Meyer said. "His added duties will be extremely valuable to me, particularly in view of TPEG's pending acquisition of Grosso/Jacobson Entertainment."

The company said Michael Levy, a Producers board member since 1995, resigned simultaneously with Dempsey's appointment. Levy stated he wanted to focus on his recent association with the Crosby/Levy management/production company.
